properties.label: Single terminal workflow story
properties.text: Float one carefully proportioned terminal window in a dark stage, using a narrow title bar and a readable sequence of command, observation, decision and output lines.

properties.label: Readable tabular terminal type
properties.text: Set meaningful terminal lines in a clear tabular monospace with consistent indentation and enough line height for a short workflow story.

properties.label: Graphite terminal with mint status
properties.text: Use an almost-black outer field, slightly lifted graphite terminal, tiny muted window dots and mint status words.

properties.label: Crisp lifted terminal frame
properties.text: Give the terminal a crisp frame and deep broad shadow, deriving texture from meaningful lines rather than dense random code.

properties.label: Brief terminal line sequence
properties.text: Reveal complete lines in a short readable sequence, hold the final result and provide replay only when it helps.

properties.label: Illustrative run disclosure
properties.text: Label the example illustrative unless it is an actual captured run, and never imply that displayed commands were executed.

properties.label: Complete terminal acceptance
properties.text: Keep all lines visible at rest, wrap long paths on mobile without horizontal clipping and never let replay erase content someone is reading.
